name: Turning Night
source:
It’s finally time! Your lovers, Louvenia and Scarlet, are ready to turn you into a vampire like them. 
You’re packing up and moving, getting ready to start a brand new life in your brand new state, with your beloved girlfriends. And you’re so ready for it!

…Right?

[From [url=https://mixtress.itch.io/turning-night]itch.io[/url]]
